swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): A ball released from rest at the top of a frictionless slide reaches the same speed at the bottom regardless of the shape of the slide. Reason (R): The speed at the bottom depends only on the height of the slide, since mechanical energy is conserved and mgh converts entirely to 1/2 m v squared.

add.q: Assertion (A): A ball released from rest at the top of a frictionless slide reaches the same speed at the bottom regardless of the shape of the slide. Reason (R): This is because the ball's kinetic energy at the bottom equals the work done by the normal force from the slide's surface as the ball moves along it. Choose the correct option.
add.a: A is true, R is false
o: A is true, R is false
A is false, R is true
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A

swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): A movable pulley system with mechanical advantage 4 allows a person to lift a heavy load using only a quarter of its weight as effort. Reason (R): The mechanical advantage of a pulley system is defined as the load divided by the effort, so an effort of one-quarter the load gives a mechanical advantage of 4.

add.q: Assertion (A): A movable pulley system with mechanical advantage 4 allows a person to lift a heavy load using only a quarter of its weight as effort. Reason (R): Mechanical energy is conserved when only gravity acts on an object, with no friction or air resistance. Choose the correct option.
add.a: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
o: Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is false, R is true
A is true, R is false
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
